title: Aayush Wellness enters shilajit segment with launch of Himalayan drops
description:
Aayush Wellness Ltd has entered the shilajit-based wellness supplement segment with the launch of Himalayan Shilajit Drops, seeking to diversify its nutraceutical portfolio and tap growing demand for products targeting energy, stamina and vitality.
The launch comes amid projected growth in the global shilajit market, which was valued at USD 206.64 million in 2025 and is expected to reach USD 436.72 million by 2034, expanding at a compound annual growth rate of 8.67 per cent during 2026-34, the company said in a statement.
Asia-Pacific accounted for around 61 per cent of the global market in 2025, while liquid shilajit products made up 60.72 per cent, indicating the growing relevance of the region and liquid formulations, it said.
